messages.subject: Staggered-Entry ( ) ?
parts:
Hello Unmakeders,

I hope you are all having a great day.

I was wondering if there is a function that estimates psi and p using Staggered-entry (Kendall et al. 2013)?


Background if needed:
I am trying to estimate psi and p of mice over a 2 month period in the summer (10 observations, 4 habitat types, and ~400 sites).
I am having some trouble deciding which model I should start with. I have been using occu( ) for single-season in UNMARKED. I am really confident in the results until I get to a species that had a low capture yield. I put my models in PRESENCE and the Staggered-entry seemed to be the best model to use. I am hesitant to use colext ( ) because it's really the same "season" biologically for these animals, or does it matter?

I am fairly new to group and to occupancy modeling so I apologize if this has been addressed. Thank you and I am grateful for any insight.

Thank you for your time,
Ally

----
Allyson Degrassi, Ph.D. Candidate
University of Vermont
Department of Biology
